shared_elements: large flat vertical wall face treated as a carved panel
possible traces of standing human figures in a horizontal upper zone
faint horizontal division/registration of the surface
justification: A shows a highly specific scheme of stacked horizontal registers filled with processions of profile standing figures carrying staffs and leading animals, with rosette-bordered bands and a stairway; B shows an essentially blank rock face where at most faint indeterminate traces near the top could be figures or signs. The only correspondence is the generic notion of a large vertical wall panel bearing relief with a possible upper band of figural work, which any carving tradition could produce, and the specific processional iconography of A has no visible counterpart in B.
